title: KS-1785: approve a secret-file guard hook for platform-k, with the local-only exemption that PS-1387 gives platform-s?
bluf: The ticket asks you to decide scope ('Proposed scope (for the owner to decide)'; item 2 'if Kamil agrees'). The hook lives in the repo, so it would bind every Claude Code session on platform-k, Peter's included (inference; UNMEASURED for Peter's setup).
